facts.fact: The ECOWAS Commission says SIGMAT, its interconnected transit-goods system for electronic data exchange between Member States, has been in use by implementing states since 2019, and that a 21-25 July 2025 mission to Ghana resolved the technical and functional challenges hindering transit between Cote d'Ivoire and Ghana.

CIV.note: No rule on sending personal data abroad is mentioned.

GHA.note: SIGMAT is a shared customs system, not a digital link or facility of the kind asked.
No treaty, ratification or transposing national law is mentioned.
An ECOWAS technical mission to Ghana states no digital policy agreement, signing or hosting by Ghana.
